public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, [and] to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord of hosts has purposed to bring down all the pride of the glorious ones, and to disgrace every glorious thing on the earth.

pob.text: Pass through your land like the Nile[a], daughter of Tarshish[c][b]; there is no restraint anymore.

spob.text: Daughter of Tarshish, pass through your land, spreading out like the Nile in flood. Nothing holds you back anymore.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer a harbor.
public_domain_references.web: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
public_domain_references.asv: Pass through thy land as the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint any more.
public_domain_references.kjv: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: [there is] no more strength.
public_domain_references.brenton: Till thy land; for ships no more come out of Carthage.

pob.text: He has stretched out his hand over the sea[a]; he has made kingdoms tremble. Yahweh has commanded concerning Canaan[c][b], to destroy her strongholds.

spob.text: He has reached out his hand over the sea[a] and made kingdoms tremble. Yahweh has given the command concerning Canaan[b]: destroy her strongholds.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD has stretched out His hand over the sea; He has made kingdoms tremble. He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.
public_domain_references.web: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.
public_domain_references.asv: He hath stretched out his hand over the sea, he hath shaken the kingdoms: Jehovah hath given commandment concerning Canaan, to destroy the strongholds thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant [city], to destroy the strong holds thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thy hand prevails no more by sea, which troubled kings: the Lord of hosts has given a command concerning Chanaan, to destroy the strength thereof.

pob.text: He said[a], “You will exult no more, oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, cross over to Kittim[b]; even there you will find no rest.”

spob.text: He said, “Oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon,[a] you will celebrate no more. Get up and go over to Kittim.[b] Even there you will find no rest.”

public_domain_references.bsb: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon. Get up and cross over to Cyprus— even there you will find no rest.”
public_domain_references.web: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”
public_domain_references.asv: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon: arise, pass over to Kittim; even there shalt thou have no rest.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
public_domain_references.brenton: And [men] shall say, Ye shall no longer at all continue to insult and injure the daughter of Sidon: and if thou depart to the Citians, neither there shalt thou have rest.

pob.text: Look at the land of the Chaldeans—this is the people that was not[a]; Assyria appointed it for desert creatures. They set up their siege towers, they stripped her palaces bare[d][c][b], they made her a ruin.

spob.text: Look at the land of the Chaldeans—a people that did not exist, or was of no account.[a] Assyria established that land for desert creatures.[b] They set up siege towers,[c] stripped its palaces bare, and made it a ruin.

public_domain_references.bsb: Look at the land of the Chaldeans — a people now of no account. The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures; they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces. They brought it to ruin.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans: this people was not; the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness; they set up their towers; they overthrew the palaces thereof; they made it a ruin.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, [till] the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; [and] he brought it to ruin.
public_domain_references.brenton: And [if thou depart] to the land of the Chaldeans, this also is laid waste by the Assyrians, for her wall is fallen.

pob.text: Wail[a], ships of Tarshish[b], for your stronghold has been destroyed.

spob.text: Wail, ships of Tarshish, because your stronghold—the place that kept you safe—has been destroyed.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your harbor has been destroyed!
public_domain_references.web: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!
public_domain_references.asv: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for your stronghold is laid waste.
public_domain_references.kjv: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
public_domain_references.brenton: Howl, ye ships of Carthage: for your strong hold is destroyed.

pob.text: And in that day Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years[a], like the days of one king. At the end of seventy years[b], it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:

spob.text: On that day, Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—a period like one king’s lifetime.[a] When those seventy years are over, Tyre will be like the prostitute in this song:

public_domain_references.bsb: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life. But at the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:
public_domain_references.web: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.
public_domain_references.asv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it shall be unto Tyre as in the song of the harlot.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] Tyre shall be left seventy years, as the time of a king, as the time of a man: and it shall come to pass after seventy years, [that] Tyre shall be as the song of a harlot.

pob.text: Take a lyre[a], go about the city, forgotten prostitute; play skillfully, sing many songs, so that you may be remembered.

spob.text: Pick up a lyre[a] and walk around the city, you forgotten prostitute. Play it skillfully and sing song after song, so that you may be remembered.

public_domain_references.bsb: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody, sing many a song, so you will be remembered.”
public_domain_references.web: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
public_domain_references.asv: Take a harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
public_domain_references.kjv: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
public_domain_references.brenton: Take a harp, go about, O city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; play well on the harp, sing many [songs], that thou mayest be remembered.

pob.text: And it will happen at the end of seventy years that Yahweh will attend to Tyre[c][b][a], and she will return to her wages and prostitute herself with all the kingdoms of the earth on the face of the earth.

spob.text: When the seventy years are over, Yahweh will intervene in Tyre’s affairs.[a] She will return to earning a prostitute’s wages, prostituting herself with every kingdom throughout the earth.

public_domain_references.bsb: And at the end of seventy years, the LORD will restore Tyre. Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
public_domain_references.web: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.
public_domain_references.asv: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that Jehovah will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her hire, and shall play the harlot with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it shall come to pass after the seventy years, [that] God will visit Tyre, and she shall be again restored to her primitive state, and she shall be a mart for all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

pob.text: And her merchandise and her wages will be holy to Yahweh[a]; they will not be stored up or hoarded, for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh[b], for eating to satisfaction and for durable clothing.

spob.text: Her merchandise and earnings will be holy to Yahweh.[a] They will not be stored away or hoarded. Instead, her merchandise will go to those who live in Yahweh’s presence, so they can eat their fill and have durable clothing.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the LORD; they will not be stored or saved, for her profit will go to those who live before the LORD, for abundant food and fine clothing.
public_domain_references.web: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
public_domain_references.asv: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to Jehovah: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before Jehovah, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
public_domain_references.kjv: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
public_domain_references.brenton: And her trade and her gain shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be gathered for them, but for those that dwell before the Lord, [even] all her trade, to eat and drink and be filled, and for a covenant [and] a memorial before the Lord.

pob.text: Behold[a], Yahweh is emptying the earth and laying it waste[b]; he will distort its surface and scatter its inhabitants.

spob.text: See—Yahweh is emptying the earth[a] and devastating it. He will twist its surface and scatter everyone who lives on it.

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants—
public_domain_references.web: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, Jehovah maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, the Lord is about to lay waste the world, and will make it desolate, and will lay bare the surface of it, and scatter them that dwell therein.

pob.text: And it shall be: as with the people[a], so with the priest; as with the slave, so with his master; as with the female slave, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the creditor, so with the one indebted to him.

spob.text: It will be the same for the people and the priest, the slave and his master, the female slave and her mistress, the buyer and the seller, the lender and the borrower, the creditor and the person who owes him.

public_domain_references.bsb: people and priest alike, servant and master, maid and mistress, buyer and seller, lender and borrower, creditor and debtor.
public_domain_references.web: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
public_domain_references.asv: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest to him.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the people shall be as the priest, and the servant as the lord, and the maid as the mistress; the buyer shall be as the seller, the lender as the borrower, and the debtor as his creditor.

pob.text: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly plundered[a], for Yahweh has spoken this word.

spob.text: The earth[a] will be completely emptied and completely plundered, because Yahweh has spoken this word.

public_domain_references.bsb: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
public_domain_references.web: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.
public_domain_references.asv: The earth shall be utterly emptied, and utterly laid waste; for Jehovah hath spoken this word.
public_domain_references.kjv: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
public_domain_references.brenton: The earth shall be completely laid waste, and the earth shall be utterly spoiled: for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things.

pob.text: The earth mourns and withers[a]; the world wastes away and withers; the exalted people of the earth waste away.

spob.text: The earth mourns and withers. The world wastes away and withers. Those who stand high among the people of the earth[a] waste away.

public_domain_references.bsb: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.
public_domain_references.web: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
public_domain_references.asv: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the lofty people of the earth do languish.
public_domain_references.kjv: The earth mourneth [and] fadeth away, the world languisheth [and] fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
public_domain_references.brenton: The earth mourns, and the world is ruined, the lofty ones of the earth are mourning.

pob.text: The earth is defiled under its inhabitants[a], because they have transgressed laws, violated a statute[b], and broken the everlasting covenant.

spob.text: The earth is defiled by the people who live on it, because they have disobeyed laws, violated an established law,[a] and broken the everlasting covenant.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.
public_domain_references.web: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
public_domain_references.asv: The earth also is polluted under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting covenant.
public_domain_references.kjv: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
public_domain_references.brenton: And she has sinned by reason of her inhabitants; because they have transgressed the law, and changed the ordinances, [even] the everlasting covenant.

pob.text: Therefore a curse has devoured the earth[a], and those who dwell in it bear their guilt; therefore the inhabitants of the earth are scorched[c][b], and few men are left.

spob.text: That is why a curse[a] has devoured the earth.[b] Those who live on it bear their guilt. That is why the people of the earth are scorched, and only a few people remain.

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and its inhabitants must bear the guilt; the earth’s dwellers have been burned, and only a few survive.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are found guilty: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore a curse shall consume the earth, because the inhabitants thereof have sinned: therefore the dwellers in the earth shall be poor, and few men shall be left.

pob.text: The new wine mourns[a], the vine withers; all the glad of heart groan.

spob.text: The new wine mourns, and the vine withers. Everyone with a joyful heart groans.

public_domain_references.bsb: The new wine dries up, the vine withers. All the merrymakers now groan.
public_domain_references.web: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
public_domain_references.asv: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merry-hearted do sigh.
public_domain_references.kjv: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
public_domain_references.brenton: The wine shall mourn, the vine shall mourn, all the merry-hearted shall sigh.

pob.text: The mirth of tambourines has ceased[a]; the noise of the jubilant has stopped[b]; the mirth of the lyre has ceased.

spob.text: The joyful music of tambourines has ended. The noise of celebrating people has stopped. The joyful music of the lyre has ended.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
public_domain_references.web: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
public_domain_references.asv: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
public_domain_references.kjv: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
public_domain_references.brenton: The mirth of timbrels has ceased, the sound of the harp has ceased.

pob.text: They do not drink wine with a song[a]; strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.

spob.text: They do not sing as they drink wine.[a] Strong drink tastes bitter to those who drink it.

public_domain_references.bsb: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
public_domain_references.web: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
public_domain_references.asv: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
public_domain_references.kjv: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
public_domain_references.brenton: They are ashamed, they have not drunk wine; strong drink has become bitter to them that drink [it].

pob.text: The city of chaos is broken down[b][a]; every house is shut up so that none may enter.

spob.text: The city of chaos[a] lies in ruins. Every house is shut so that no one can enter.

public_domain_references.bsb: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.
public_domain_references.web: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
public_domain_references.asv: The waste city is broken down; every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
public_domain_references.kjv: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
public_domain_references.brenton: All the city has become desolate: one shall shut his house so that none shall enter.

pob.text: There is an outcry over the wine in the streets[a]; all joy has grown dark[b]; the gladness of the earth has gone away.

spob.text: There are cries of distress in the streets over the wine. All joy has grown dark,[a] and the earth’s gladness has gone away.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom; rejoicing is exiled from the land.
public_domain_references.web: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
public_domain_references.asv: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
public_domain_references.kjv: [There is] a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
public_domain_references.brenton: There is a howling for the wine everywhere; all the mirth of the land has ceased, all the mirth of the land has departed.

pob.text: Desolation is left in the city[a], and the gate is battered into ruins.

spob.text: Desolation remains in the city, and its gate is battered into ruins.

public_domain_references.bsb: The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.
public_domain_references.web: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
public_domain_references.asv: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
public_domain_references.kjv: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
public_domain_references.brenton: And cities shall be left desolate, and houses being left shall fall to ruin.

pob.text: For so it will be in the midst of the earth[a], among the peoples: like the beating of an olive tree[b], like gleanings when the grape harvest is finished.

spob.text: For this is what it will be like throughout the earth, among the peoples: like the few olives left after an olive tree is beaten, and like the few grapes left after the grape harvest is over.

public_domain_references.bsb: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.
public_domain_references.web: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
public_domain_references.asv: For thus shall it be in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive-tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, [there shall be] as the shaking of an olive tree, [and] as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
public_domain_references.brenton: All this shall be in the land in the midst of the nations, as if one should strip an olive tree, so shall they strip them; but when the vintage is done,

pob.text: They lift up their voice; they shout for joy. At the majesty of Yahweh[a], they cry aloud from the sea.

spob.text: They raise their voices and shout for joy. Because of Yahweh’s majesty, they cry aloud from the sea.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.
public_domain_references.asv: These shall lift up their voice, they shall shout; for the majesty of Jehovah they cry aloud from the sea.
public_domain_references.kjv: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
public_domain_references.brenton: these shall cry aloud; and they that are left on the land shall rejoice together in the glory of the Lord: the water of the sea shall be troubled.

pob.text: Therefore in the east give glory to Yahweh; in the coastlands of the sea[a], to the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

spob.text: Therefore, give glory to Yahweh in the east. In the coastlands of the sea, give glory to the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east. Extol the name of the LORD, the God of Israel in the islands of the sea.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore glorify ye Jehovah in the east, even the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel, in the isles of the sea.
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, [even] the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore shall the glory of the Lord be in the isles of the sea; the name of the Lord shall be glorious.

pob.text: From the edge of the earth we hear songs: “Glory to the righteous one.” But I say[a], “I waste away, I waste away. Woe is me!” The treacherous deal treacherously[c][b]; with treachery the treacherous deal treacherously.

spob.text: From the edge of the earth[a] we hear songs: “Glory to the righteous one.”[b] But I say, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me! The treacherous act treacherously; they commit treachery upon treachery.”[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.
public_domain_references.web: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
public_domain_references.asv: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs: Glory to the righteous. But I said, I pine away, I pine away, woe is me! the treacherous have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, [even] glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
public_domain_references.brenton: O Lord God of Israel, from the ends of the earth we have heard wonderful things, [and there is] hope to the godly: but they shall say, Woe to the despisers, that despise the law.

pob.text: Terror and the pit and the snare are upon you[a], inhabitant of the earth.

spob.text: Everyone who lives on the earth faces terror, the pit, and the snare.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.
public_domain_references.web: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
public_domain_references.asv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

pob.text: My soul has desired you in the night[a]; indeed, my spirit within me seeks you early. For when your judgments are in the earth[c][b], the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

spob.text: My soul longs for you in the night; deep within me, my spirit seeks you at dawn.[a] For when your judgments are on the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness—how to live rightly.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
public_domain_references.web: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
public_domain_references.asv: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee earnestly: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
public_domain_references.kjv: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments [are] in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
public_domain_references.brenton: which our soul longs for: my spirit seeks thee very early in the morning, O God, for thy commandments are a light on the earth: learn righteousness, ye that dwell upon the earth.

pob.text: Though favor is shown to the wicked[a], he does not learn righteousness; in a land of uprightness he acts unjustly[e][d][c][b], and he does not see the majesty of Yahweh.

spob.text: Though wicked people are shown favor[a], they do not learn what is right. In a land where people do what is right, they act unjustly and do not recognize Yahweh’s majesty.

public_domain_references.bsb: Though grace is shown to the wicked man, he does not learn righteousness. In the land of righteousness he acts unjustly and fails to see the majesty of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.
public_domain_references.asv: Let favor be showed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness will he deal wrongfully, and will not behold the majesty of Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, [yet] will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: For the ungodly one is put down: no one who will not learn righteousness on the earth, shall be able to do the truth: let the ungodly be taken away, that he see not the glory of the Lord.

pob.text: O Yahweh[a], your hand is lifted up, but they do not see. They will see and be put to shame by the zeal for your people; indeed[b], the fire for your enemies will consume them.

spob.text: O Yahweh, your hand is raised, but they do not see it. They will see your zeal for your people[a] and be put to shame. Yes, the fire directed at your enemies[b] will consume them.

public_domain_references.bsb: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah, thy hand is lifted up, yet they see not: but they shall see [thy] zeal for the people, and be put to shame; yea, fire shall devour thine adversaries.
public_domain_references.kjv: LORD, [when] thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: [but] they shall see, and be ashamed for [their] envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
public_domain_references.brenton: O Lord, thine arm is exalted, yet they knew it not: but when they know they shall be ashamed: jealousy shall seize upon an untaught nation, and now fire shall devour the adversaries.

pob.text: O Yahweh[a], you will establish peace for us[b], for indeed you have accomplished all our works for us.

spob.text: Yahweh, you will make peace a reality for us.[a] After all, you have brought about all our work for us.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah, thou wilt ordain peace for us; for thou hast also wrought all our works for us.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
public_domain_references.brenton: O Lord our God, give us peace: for thou hast rendered to us all things.

pob.text: O Yahweh our God[a], other lords besides you have ruled over us, but through you alone we make mention of your name.

spob.text: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us. But through you alone we mention your name.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: O LORD our God, other lords besides You have had dominion, but Your name alone do we confess.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
public_domain_references.asv: O Jehovah our God, other lords besides thee have had dominion over us; but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
public_domain_references.kjv: O LORD our God, [other] lords beside thee have had dominion over us: [but] by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
public_domain_references.brenton: O Lord our God, take possession of us: O Lord, we know not [any] other beside thee: we name thy name.

pob.text: The dead do not live[a]; the shades do not rise. Therefore you have punished them and destroyed them[c][b], and you have made all memory of them perish.

spob.text: The dead do not live; the spirits of the dead do not rise.[a] So you punished and destroyed them, wiping out every memory of them.

public_domain_references.bsb: The dead will not live; the departed spirits will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them; You have wiped out all memory of them.
public_domain_references.web: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
public_domain_references.asv: [They are] dead, they shall not live; [they are] deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all remembrance of them to perish.
public_domain_references.kjv: [They are] dead, they shall not live; [they are] deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
public_domain_references.brenton: But the dead shall not see life, neither shall physicians by any means raise [them] up: therefore thou hast brought [wrath] upon [them], and slain [them], and hast taken away every male of them. Bring more evils upon them, O Lord;

pob.text: You have increased the nation[a], O Yahweh; you have increased the nation; you have gained glory[b]; you have extended all the borders of the land.

spob.text: Yahweh, you have made the nation grow; you have made it grow. You have gained glory[a] and extended all the borders of the land.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: You have enlarged the nation, O LORD; You have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for Yourself; You have extended all the borders of the land.
public_domain_references.web: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou hast increased the nation, O Jehovah, thou hast increased the nation; thou art glorified; thou hast enlarged all the borders of the land.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed [it] far [unto] all the ends of the earth.
public_domain_references.brenton: bring more evils on the glorious ones of the earth.

pob.text: O Yahweh[a], in distress they sought you[c][b]; they poured out a whispered prayer when your discipline was upon them.

spob.text: Yahweh, when they were in distress, they sought you.[a] When your discipline came upon them,[b] they poured out a prayer in whispers.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: O LORD, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah, in trouble have they visited thee; they poured out a prayer [when] thy chastening was upon them.
public_domain_references.kjv: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer [when] thy chastening [was] upon them.
public_domain_references.brenton: Lord, in affliction I remembered thee; thy chastening was to us with small affliction.

pob.text: Like a pregnant woman who is about to give birth writhes and cries out in her labor pains[a], so were we before you, O Yahweh.

spob.text: Yahweh, before you we were like a pregnant woman about to give birth, writhing and crying out in her labor pains.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: As a woman with child about to give birth writhes and cries out in pain, so were we in Your presence, O LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain and crieth out in her pangs; so we have been before thee, O Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Like as a woman with child, [that] draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, [and] crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And as a woman in travail draws nigh to be delivered, [and] cries out in her pain; so have we been to thy beloved.

pob.text: We were pregnant[a], we writhed in labor; as it were, we gave birth to wind. We accomplished no deliverance in the earth[c][b], and the inhabitants of the world were not born.

spob.text: We became pregnant[a] and writhed in labor, but it was as though we gave birth to wind.[b] We brought no deliverance to the earth, and the people of the world did not fall.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: We were with child; we writhed in pain; but we gave birth to wind. We have given no salvation to the earth, nor brought any life into the world.
public_domain_references.web: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
public_domain_references.asv: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
public_domain_references.kjv: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
public_domain_references.brenton: We have conceived, O Lord, because of thy fear, and have been in pain, and have brought forth the breath of thy salvation, which we have wrought upon the earth: we shall not fall, but all that dwell upon the land shall fall.

pob.text: Your dead will live[a]; my dead bodies will rise. Awake and shout for joy, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is a dew of lights[c][b], and the earth will cast out the dead.

spob.text: Your dead will come back to life; my dead bodies will rise.[a] Wake up and shout for joy, you who lie in the dust! For your dew is a dew of light,[b] and the earth will cast out the dead.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
public_domain_references.web: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
public_domain_references.asv: Thy dead shall live; my dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in the dust; for thy dew is [as] the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast forth the dead.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thy dead [men] shall live, [together with] my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew [is as] the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
public_domain_references.brenton: The dead shall rise, and they that are in the tombs shall be raised, and they that are in the earth shall rejoice: for the dew from thee is healing to them: but the land of the ungodly shall perish.

pob.text: Go[a], my people, enter your rooms, and shut your doors behind you[c][b]; hide yourselves for a little moment until the wrath has passed by.

spob.text: Go, my people. Enter your rooms and close the doors behind you. Hide yourselves for a little while, until the wrath has passed by.

public_domain_references.bsb: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
public_domain_references.web: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
public_domain_references.asv: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
public_domain_references.brenton: Go, my people, enter into thy closets, shut thy door, hide thyself for a little season, until the anger of the Lord have passed away.

pob.text: For look, the LORD is coming out from his place to punish the iniquity of the inhabitant of the earth upon him, and the earth will uncover her blood and will no longer cover her slain.

spob.text: Look! The LORD is coming from his place to punish the people of the earth for their sin. The earth will reveal the blood shed on it and will no longer hide those who were killed.

public_domain_references.bsb: For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
public_domain_references.web: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
public_domain_references.asv: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
public_domain_references.kjv: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
public_domain_references.brenton: For, behold, the Lord is bringing wrath from [his] holy place upon the dwellers on the earth: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall not cover her slain.

pob.text: In that day Yahweh will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent[a], Leviathan the twisting serpent, with his fierce and great and strong sword[c][b]; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

spob.text: In that day, Yahweh will use his fierce, great, and strong sword to punish Leviathan—the fleeing serpent[a], Leviathan—the twisting serpent[b]. He will kill the dragon[c] in the sea.

public_domain_references.bsb: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent —Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
public_domain_references.web: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
public_domain_references.asv: In that day Jehovah with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan the swift serpent, and leviathan the crooked serpent; and he will slay the monster that is in the sea.
public_domain_references.kjv: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that [is] in the sea.
public_domain_references.brenton: In that day God shall bring [his] holy and great and strong sword upon the dragon, even the serpent that flees, upon the dragon, the crooked serpent: he shall destroy the dragon.

pob.text: In that day: “A pleasant vineyard”—sing of it![a][b]

spob.text: In that day, sing about the pleasant vineyard![a]

public_domain_references.bsb: In that day: “Sing about a fruitful vineyard.
public_domain_references.web: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
public_domain_references.asv: In that day: A vineyard of wine, sing ye unto it.
public_domain_references.kjv: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
public_domain_references.brenton: In that day [there shall be] a fair vineyard, [and] a desire to commence [a song] concerning it.

pob.text: I[a], Yahweh, am its keeper[b]; I water it continually. Lest anyone punish it, I guard it night and day.

spob.text: I, Yahweh, watch over this vineyard. I water it continually. I guard it night and day so that no one will harm it.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
public_domain_references.web: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
public_domain_references.asv: I Jehovah am its keeper; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
public_domain_references.kjv: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest [any] hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
public_domain_references.brenton: I am a strong city, a city in a siege: in vain shall I water it; for it shall be taken by night, and by day the wall shall fall.

pob.text: I have no wrath[a]. Who would set briers and thorns against me in battle? I would march against them[b]; I would burn them up together.

spob.text: I have no wrath. Who would bring thornbushes and thorns to fight me?[a] I would advance against them and burn them all at once.

public_domain_references.bsb: I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.
public_domain_references.web: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
public_domain_references.asv: Wrath is not in me: would that the briers and thorns were against me in battle! I would march upon them, I would burn them together.
public_domain_references.kjv: Fury [is] not in me: who would set the briers [and] thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
public_domain_references.brenton: There is no woman that has not taken hold of it; who will set me to watch stubble in the field? because of this enemy I have set her aside; therefore on this account the Lord has done all that he appointed.

pob.text: Or let him take hold of my strength[a]; let him make peace with me; let him make peace with me.

spob.text: Or let him take hold of my strength for protection.[a] Let him make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.

public_domain_references.bsb: Or let them lay claim to My protection; let them make peace with Me— yes, let them make peace with Me.”
public_domain_references.web: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
public_domain_references.asv: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; [yea], let him make peace with me.
public_domain_references.kjv: Or let him take hold of my strength, [that] he may make peace with me; [and] he shall make peace with me.
public_domain_references.brenton: I am burnt up; they that dwell in her shall cry, Let us make peace with him, let us make peace,

pob.text: In days to come Jacob will take root[a]; Israel will blossom and flower[b], and they will fill the face of the world with fruit.

spob.text: In the days ahead, Jacob will put down roots. Israel will bud and bloom, and they will fill the world with fruit.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.
public_domain_references.web: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
public_domain_references.asv: In days to come shall Jacob take root; Israel shall blossom and bud; and they shall fill the face of the world with fruit.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
public_domain_references.brenton: they that are coming are the children of Jacob. Israel shall bud and blossom, and the world shall be filled with his fruit.

pob.text: Has he struck him as he struck the one who struck him? Or has he been killed as his slain were killed?[a][b]

spob.text: Did he strike him as he struck his attacker? Or was he killed as his slain were killed?[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors? Was she killed like those who slayed her?
public_domain_references.web: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
public_domain_references.asv: Hath he smitten them as he smote those that smote them? or are they slain according to the slaughter of them that were slain by them?
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? [or] is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
public_domain_references.brenton: Shall he himself be thus smitten, even as he smote? and as he slew, shall he be thus slain?

pob.text: By measure[a], when you sent her away, you contended with her[c][b]; he drove her out with his fierce wind on the day of the east wind.

spob.text: You brought measured judgment against her[a] when you sent her away.[b] He drove her out with his fierce wind on the day the east wind blew.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind, as on the day the east wind blows.
public_domain_references.web: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
public_domain_references.asv: In measure, when thou sendest them away, thou dost contend with them; he hath removed [them] with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
public_domain_references.kjv: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
public_domain_references.brenton: Fighting and reproaching he will dismiss them; didst thou not meditate with a harsh spirit, to slay them with a wrathful spirit?

pob.text: Therefore by this the guilt of Jacob will be atoned for, and this will be the full fruit of the removal of his sin: when he makes all the stones of the altar like crushed chalkstones, the Asherah poles and incense altars will not stand.

spob.text: Therefore, through this, Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for. This will be the full result of taking away his sin: when he turns all the stones of the altar into crushed chalk, no Asherah pole[a] or incense altar will remain standing.

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore by this shall the iniquity of Jacob be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, [so that] the Asherim and the sun-images shall rise no more.
public_domain_references.kjv: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this [is] all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be taken away; and this is his blessing, when I shall have taken away his sin; when they shall have broken to pieces all the stones of the altars as fine dust, and their trees shall not remain, and their idols shall be cut off, as a thicket afar off.

pob.text: For the fortified city is solitary[a], a habitation deserted and abandoned like the wilderness; there a calf grazes[b], and there it lies down and strips its branches bare.

spob.text: For the fortified city stands alone. The place where people lived is deserted and abandoned like the wilderness.[a] A calf grazes there and lies down there; it strips the city's branches bare.

public_domain_references.bsb: For the fortified city lies deserted— a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken. There the calves graze, and there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
public_domain_references.web: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
public_domain_references.asv: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yet the defenced city [shall be] desolate, [and] the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: The flock that dwelt [there] shall be left, as a deserted flock; and [the ground] shall be for a long time for pasture, and there shall flocks lie down to rest.

pob.text: When its harvest dries up[a], it is broken; women come and make a fire with it. For this is not a people of understanding; therefore its Maker will not have compassion on it[b], and the one who formed it will show it no favor.

spob.text: When its harvest dries up[a], it is broken into pieces. Women come and use it to make fires. These people do not understand. Therefore, their Maker will have no compassion on them, and the one who formed them will show them no favor.

public_domain_references.bsb: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off. Women come and use them for kindling; for this is a people without understanding. Therefore their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.
public_domain_references.web: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.
public_domain_references.asv: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off; the women shall come, and set them on fire; for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have compassion upon them, and he that formed them will show them no favor.
public_domain_references.kjv: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, [and] set them on fire: for it [is] a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
public_domain_references.brenton: And after a time there shall be in it no green thing because of [the grass] being parched. Come hither, ye women that come from a sight; for it is a people of no understanding; therefore he that made them shall have no pity upon them, and he that formed them shall have no mercy [upon them].

pob.text: And in that day Yahweh will thresh from the channel of the River to the Wadi of Egypt[a], and you will be gathered one by one[d][c][b], O sons of Israel.

spob.text: In that day, Yahweh will thresh from the channel of the River to the Wadi of Egypt.[a] Then you, sons of Israel, will be gathered one by one.

public_domain_references.bsb: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.

pob.text: Does the plowman plow all day to sow? Does he keep opening and harrowing his ground?[a]

public_domain_references.web: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.
public_domain_references.asv: For the fitches are not threshed with a sharp [threshing] instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

pob.text: This also has come from Yahweh of hosts[a]; he is wonderful in counsel and great in wisdom.

spob.text: This too has come from Yahweh of Armies.[a] His plans are wonderful, and his practical wisdom is great.[b]

pob.text: Ah[a], Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts run their round.

public_domain_references.kjv: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city [where] David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
public_domain_references.brenton: Alas for the city Ariel, which David besieged. Gather ye fruits year by year; eat ye, for ye shall eat with Moab.

pob.text: And I will distress Ariel[a], and there will be mourning and lamentation, and she will be to me like an altar hearth.

spob.text: I will bring suffering on Ariel[a]. There will be mourning and cries of sorrow, and she will become like an altar hearth to me.

pob.text: And I will encamp against you all around[a], and I will besiege you with siegeworks[c][b], and I will raise up siege towers against you.

spob.text: I will camp all around you. I will besiege you with fortified positions and set up siege towers against you.[a]

pob.text: Then you will be brought low; from the earth you will speak[a], and from the dust your speech will be low. Your voice will be like that of a medium from the earth, and from the dust your speech will chirp.

spob.text: Then you will be brought low to the ground. You will speak from the earth, and your words from the dust will be faint. Your voice will sound like the voice of a medium coming from the earth; your words will chirp from the dust.[a]

pob.text: But the multitude of your strangers shall become like fine dust[a], and the multitude of the ruthless like passing chaff; and it shall happen suddenly[b], in an instant.

spob.text: But the crowd of foreigners attacking you[a] will become like fine dust, and the crowd of ruthless people will be like chaff that blows away. This will happen suddenly, in an instant.

public_domain_references.asv: But the multitude of thy foes shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be in an instant suddenly.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones [shall be] as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

pob.text: Be stunned and be astonished[a]; blind yourselves and be blind. They are drunk, but not with wine; they stagger[b], but not from strong drink.

pob.text: And the Lord said: Because this people draws near with its mouth and honors me with its lips[a], while its heart is far from me, and their fear of me has become a commandment of men that is taught[b],

pob.text: You turn things upside down! Shall the potter be regarded as clay[a], that what is made should say of its maker, “He did not make me,” and what is formed say of the one who formed it, “He has no understanding”?

public_domain_references.kjv: [Is] it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

spob.text:
A prophetic message about the animals of the Negev:[a]

People travel through a land of danger and hardship, with lionesses and lions,[b] vipers, and flying fiery serpents. They carry their wealth on the shoulders of donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people who cannot benefit them.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: This is the burden against the beasts of the Negev: Through a land of hardship and distress, of lioness and lion, of viper and flying serpent, they carry their wealth on the backs of donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people of no profit to them.
public_domain_references.web: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.
public_domain_references.asv: The burden of the beasts of the South. In affliction and distress, [where are] the lion and lion's whelp, thence [come] also asps, and the young of flying asps, [there shall they be] who bore their wealth on asses and camels to a nation which shall not profit them.
