public_domain_references.web: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.
public_domain_references.asv: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair; I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
public_domain_references.kjv: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
public_domain_references.brenton: I gave my back to scourges, and my cheeks to blows; and I turned not away my face from the shame of spitting:

pob.text: But the Lord GOD helps me[a]; therefore I have not been disgraced. Therefore I have set my face like flint[d][c][b], and I know that I will not be put to shame.

spob.text: But the Lord Yahweh[a] helps me. For that reason, I have not been disgraced. For that reason, I am determined to stand firm; I have set my face like flint. I know that I will not be put to shame.

public_domain_references.bsb: Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.
public_domain_references.web: For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.
public_domain_references.asv: For the Lord Jehovah will help me; therefore have I not been confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
public_domain_references.brenton: but the Lord God became my helper; therefore I was not ashamed, but I set my face as a solid rock; and I know that I shall never be ashamed,

pob.text: Near is the one who vindicates me[a]; who will contend with me? Let us stand together[b]. Who is the master of my case? Let him come near to me.

spob.text: The one who declares me to be in the right is near. Who will bring a case against me? Let us stand together in court. Who has a legal claim against me? Let him come near me.

public_domain_references.bsb: The One who vindicates Me is near. Who will dare to contend with Me? Let us confront each other! Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me!
public_domain_references.web: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.
public_domain_references.asv: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand up together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
public_domain_references.kjv: [He is] near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who [is] mine adversary? let him come near to me.
public_domain_references.brenton: for he that has justified me draws near; who is he that pleads with me? let him stand up against me at the same time: yea, who is he that pleads with me? let him draw nigh to me.

pob.text: Behold[a], the Lord GOD helps me; who is he who will declare me guilty? Behold, all of them will wear out like a garment; a moth will eat them.

spob.text: Look! The Lord GOD helps me. Who, then, will declare me guilty?[a] Look! They will all wear out like a piece of clothing; a moth will eat them up.

public_domain_references.bsb: Surely the Lord GOD helps Me. Who is there to condemn Me? See, they will all wear out like a garment; the moths will devour them.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? behold, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who [is] he [that] shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, the Lord, the Lord, will help me; who will hurt me? behold, all ye shall wax old as a garment, and a moth shall devour you.

pob.text: Who among you fears Yahweh[a], listening to the voice of his servant? Let the one who walks in darkness and has no light trust in the name of Yahweh and lean on his God.

spob.text: Who among you fears Yahweh and listens to the voice of his servant?[a] Let the person who walks in darkness and has no light trust in Yahweh’s name and lean on their God.

public_domain_references.bsb: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.
public_domain_references.web: Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in Yahweh’s name, and rely on his God.
public_domain_references.asv: Who is among you that feareth Jehovah, that obeyeth the voice of his servant? he that walketh in darkness, and hath no light, let him trust in the name of Jehovah, and rely upon his God.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Who [is] among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh [in] darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
public_domain_references.brenton: Who is among you that fears the Lord? let him hearken to the voice of his servant: ye that walk in darkness, and have no light, trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon God.

pob.text: Look[a], all of you who kindle a fire, who gird yourselves with burning arrows: walk in the light of your fire and among the arrows you have set ablaze[b]. This has come to you from my hand: you will lie down in torment.

spob.text: Look, all of you who light your own fire and arm yourselves with burning arrows.[a] Walk by the light of your fire and among the arrows you have set ablaze. This comes to you from my hand: you will lie down in torment.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who array yourselves with firebrands, walk in the light of your fire and of the firebrands you have lit! This is what you will receive from My hand: You will lie down in a place of torment.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that gird yourselves about with firebrands; walk ye in the flame of your fire, and among the brands that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of my hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass [yourselves] about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks [that] ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, ye all kindle a fire, and feed a flame: walk in the light of your fire, and in the flame which ye have kindled. This has happened to you for my sake; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

pob.text: Listen to me[a], you who pursue righteousness, you who seek Yahweh: look to the rock from which you were cut[c][b], and to the quarry from which you were dug.

spob.text: All of you who pursue righteousness[a] and seek Yahweh, listen to me. Think about the rock you were cut from and the quarry you were dug from.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: “Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut, and to the quarry from which you were hewn.
public_domain_references.web: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek Yahweh. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.
public_domain_references.asv: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek Jehovah: look unto the rock whence ye were hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye were digged.
public_domain_references.kjv: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock [whence] ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit [whence] ye are digged.
public_domain_references.brenton: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, and seek the Lord: look to the solid rock, which ye have hewn, and to the hole of the pit which ye have dug.

pob.text: Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who bore you; for I called him when he was one[a], and I blessed him and multiplied him.

spob.text: Look back to Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, who gave birth to you. When I called Abraham, he was only one man.[a] I blessed him and made his descendants many.

public_domain_references.bsb: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who gave you birth. When I called him, he was but one; then I blessed him and multiplied him.
public_domain_references.web: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.
public_domain_references.asv: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you; for when he was but one I called him, and I blessed him, and made him many.
public_domain_references.kjv: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah [that] bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
public_domain_references.brenton: Look to Abraam your father, and to Sarrha that bore you: for he was alone when I called him, and blessed him, and loved him, and multiplied him.

pob.text: For Yahweh comforts Zion[a]; he comforts all her ruins. He makes her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahweh. Joy and gladness will be found in her[d][c][b], thanksgiving and the sound of song.

spob.text: For Yahweh comforts Zion; he brings comfort to all her ruined places. He makes her wilderness like Eden and her desert plain like Yahweh’s garden. There will be joy and gladness in her, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.

public_domain_references.bsb: For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.
public_domain_references.web: For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahweh. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
public_domain_references.asv: For Jehovah hath comforted Zion; he hath comforted all her waste places, and hath made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Jehovah; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
public_domain_references.brenton: And now I will comfort thee, O Sion: and I have comforted all her desert places; and I will make her desert places as a garden, and her western places as the garden of the Lord; they shall find in her gladness and exultation, thanksgiving and the voice of praise.

pob.text: Pay attention to me[a], my people, and give ear to me, my nation; for instruction will go out from me[c][b], and I will set my justice as a light for the peoples.

spob.text: Listen closely to me, my people. Hear me, my nation. My instruction[a] will go out from me, and I will establish my justice[b][c] as a light for the nations.

public_domain_references.bsb: Pay attention to Me, My people, and listen to Me, My nation; for a law will go out from Me, and My justice will become a light to the nations; I will bring it about quickly.
public_domain_references.web: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.
public_domain_references.asv: Attend unto me, O my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall go forth from me, and I will establish my justice for a light of the peoples.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
public_domain_references.brenton: Hear me, hear me, my people; and ye kings, hearken to me: for a law shall proceed from me, and my judgment [shall be] for a light of the nations.

pob.text: My righteousness is near[a], my salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples; the coastlands will wait for me[c][b], and for my arm they will hope.

spob.text: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out. My arms will judge the peoples. Distant coastlands will wait for me and hope for my powerful arm.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: My righteousness draws near, My salvation is on the way, and My arms will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.
public_domain_references.web: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.
public_domain_references.asv: My righteousness is near, my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the peoples; the isles shall wait for me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
public_domain_references.kjv: My righteousness [is] near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
public_domain_references.brenton: My righteousness speedily draws nigh, and my salvation shall go forth as light, and on mine arm shall the Gentiles trust: the isles shall wait for me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

pob.text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens[a], and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment, and its inhabitants will die likewise. But my salvation will be forever[b], and my righteousness will not be shattered.

spob.text: Look up at the heavens, and look down at the earth. For the heavens will vanish like smoke.[a] The earth will wear out like a garment, and the people who live on it will die like gnats.[b] But my salvation will last forever, and my righteousness[c] will never be broken.

public_domain_references.bsb: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth below; for the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment, and its people will die like gnats. But My salvation will last forever, and My righteousness will never fail.
public_domain_references.web: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.
public_domain_references.asv: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath; for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment; and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
public_domain_references.kjv: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
public_domain_references.brenton: Lift up your eyes to the sky, and look on the earth beneath: for the sky was darkened like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and the inhabitants shall die in like manner: but my righteousness shall not fail.

pob.text: Listen to me[a], you who know righteousness, people with my law in their hearts: do not fear the reproach of man[d][c][b], and do not be dismayed by their insults.

spob.text: Listen to me, you who know righteousness,[a] people who have my law in your hearts.[b] Do not fear the scorn of man,[c] and do not let their insults shatter you.

public_domain_references.bsb: Listen to Me, you who know what is right, you people with My law in your hearts: Do not fear the scorn of men; do not be broken by their insults.
public_domain_references.web: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.
public_domain_references.asv: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye dismayed at their revilings.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart [is] my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
public_domain_references.brenton: Hear me, ye that know judgment, the people in whose heart is my law: fear not the reproach of men, and be not overcome by their contempt.

pob.text: For the moth will eat them like a garment[a], and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to generation after generation.

spob.text: For moths will eat them up as if they were clothing, and worms will eat them up as if they were wool. But my righteousness[a] will last forever, and my salvation will continue through every generation.

public_domain_references.bsb: For the moth will devour them like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will last forever, My salvation through all generations.”
public_domain_references.web: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”
public_domain_references.asv: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool; but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation unto all generations.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
public_domain_references.brenton: For as a garment will be devoured by time, and as wool will be devoured by a moth, [so shall they be consumed]; but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation for all generations.

pob.text: Awake[a], awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh; awake, as in days of old, generations of long ago[b]. Was it not you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the dragon?

spob.text: Arm of Yahweh, awake! Awake! Put on your strength. Awake and act as you did in ancient days, in generations long past. Was it not you who cut Rahab[a] to pieces and pierced the dragon[b]?

public_domain_references.bsb: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?
public_domain_references.web: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?
public_domain_references.asv: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Jehovah; awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Is it not thou that didst cut Rahab in pieces, that didst pierce the monster?
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. [Art] thou not it that hath cut Rahab, [and] wounded the dragon?
public_domain_references.brenton: Awake, awake, O Jerusalem, and put on the strength of thine arm; awake as in the early time, as the ancient generation.

pob.text: Was it not you who dried up the sea[a], the waters of the great deep[b], who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to cross over?

spob.text: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep? Was it not you who made a path through the depths of the sea so the redeemed could cross over?

public_domain_references.bsb: Was it not You who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea for the redeemed to cross over?
public_domain_references.web: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?
public_domain_references.asv: Is it not thou that driedst up the sea, the waters of the great deep; that madest the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?
public_domain_references.kjv: [Art] thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
public_domain_references.brenton: Art thou not it that dried the sea, the water, [even] the abundance of the deep; that made the depths of the sea a way of passage for the delivered and redeemed?

pob.text: And the redeemed of Yahweh will return and come to Zion with singing[a]; everlasting joy will be upon their heads; gladness and joy will overtake them[b]; sorrow and sighing will flee away.

public_domain_references.bsb: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
public_domain_references.web: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
public_domain_references.asv: And the ransomed of Jehovah shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their heads: they shall obtain gladness and joy; [and] sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy [shall be] upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; [and] sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

pob.text: I[a], I am he who comforts you. Who are you that you fear man, who dies, and the son of man, who is made like grass?

public_domain_references.bsb: “I, even I, am He who comforts you. Why should you be afraid of mortal man, of a son of man who withers like grass?
public_domain_references.web: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?
public_domain_references.asv: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou art afraid of man that shall die, and of the son of man that shall be made as grass;
public_domain_references.kjv: I, [even] I, [am] he that comforteth you: who [art] thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man [that] shall die, and of the son of man [which] shall be made [as] grass;
public_domain_references.brenton: I, [even] I, am he that comforts thee: consider who thou art, that thou wast afraid of mortal man, and of the son of man, who are withered as grass.

pob.text: and you forgot Yahweh your Maker[a], who stretched out the heavens and founded the earth, and you feared continually all day long because of the fury of the oppressor, when he set himself to destroy. But where is the fury of the oppressor?

spob.text: You forgot Yahweh, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundation of the earth. All day long, you were constantly afraid of the oppressor’s fury as he prepared to destroy.[a] But where is the oppressor’s fury?

public_domain_references.bsb: But you have forgotten the LORD, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?
public_domain_references.web: Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?
public_domain_references.asv: and hast forgotten Jehovah thy Maker, that stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and fearest continually all the day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he maketh ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
public_domain_references.kjv: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where [is] the fury of the oppressor?
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou hast forgotten God who made thee, who made the sky and founded the earth; and thou wert continually afraid because of the wrath of him that afflicted thee: for [whereas] he counselled to take thee away, yet now where is the wrath of him that afflicted thee?

pob.text: The one bent low will soon be set free[a]; he will not die in the pit[b], and his bread will not be lacking.

spob.text: The one bowed down will soon be set free.[a] He will not die in the pit,[b] and he will not run out of bread.

public_domain_references.bsb: The captive will soon be freed; he will not die in the dungeon, and his bread will not be lacking.
public_domain_references.web: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.
public_domain_references.asv: The captive exile shall speedily be loosed; and he shall not die [and go down] into the pit, neither shall his bread fail.
public_domain_references.kjv: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
public_domain_references.brenton: For in thy deliverance he shall not halt, nor tarry;

pob.text: For I am Yahweh your God[b][a], who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— Yahweh of hosts is his name.

spob.text: For I am Yahweh, your God. I stir up the sea, making its waves roar.[a] Yahweh of Armies is his name.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
public_domain_references.web: For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.
public_domain_references.asv: For I am Jehovah thy God, who stirreth up the sea, so that the waves thereof roar: Jehovah of hosts is his name.
public_domain_references.kjv: But I [am] the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts [is] his name.
public_domain_references.brenton: for I am thy God, that troubles the sea, and causes the waves thereof to roar: the Lord of hosts is my name.

pob.text: And I have put my words in your mouth[a], and covered you with the shadow of my hand, to plant the heavens and to found the earth, and to say to Zion[b], ‘You are my people.’

spob.text: “I have placed my words in your mouth[a] and sheltered you under the shadow of my hand. I did this to plant the heavens,[b] lay the foundation of the earth, and say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’”

public_domain_references.bsb: I have put My words in your mouth, and covered you with the shadow of My hand, to establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’”
public_domain_references.web: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”
public_domain_references.asv: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and have covered thee in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou [art] my people.

public_domain_references.web: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.
public_domain_references.asv: He was despised, and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and as one from whom men hide their face he was despised; and we esteemed him not.
public_domain_references.kjv: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were [our] faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
public_domain_references.brenton: But his form was ignoble, and inferior to that of the children of men; [he was] a man in suffering, and acquainted with the bearing of sickness, for his face is turned from [us]: he was dishonoured, and not esteemed.

pob.text: Surely he has borne our sicknesses and carried our pains[a]; yet we considered him stricken, struck by God[b], and afflicted.

spob.text: Surely he bore our sicknesses and carried our pains;[a] yet we thought he was stricken, struck by God,[b] and afflicted.

public_domain_references.bsb: Surely He took on our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken by God, struck down and afflicted.
public_domain_references.web: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
public_domain_references.asv: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows; yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
public_domain_references.brenton: He bears our sins, and is pained for us: yet we accounted him to be in trouble, and in suffering, and in affliction.

pob.text: But he was pierced because of our transgressions[a]; he was crushed because of our iniquities; the chastisement for our peace was upon him[c][b], and by his wound we are healed.

spob.text: But he was pierced[a] because of our rebellion; he was crushed because of our sins. The punishment that brought us peace[b] was upon him, and by his wound[c] we are healed.

public_domain_references.bsb: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
public_domain_references.web: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
public_domain_references.asv: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
public_domain_references.kjv: But he [was] wounded for our transgressions, [he was] bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace [was] upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
public_domain_references.brenton: But he was wounded on account of our sins, and was bruised because of our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; [and] by his bruises we were healed.

pob.text: All of us[a], like sheep, have gone astray; each of us has turned to his own way[c][b]; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

spob.text: Like sheep, all of us have wandered away. Each of us has gone his own way. And Yahweh has laid all our wrongdoing[a] on him.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
public_domain_references.web: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
public_domain_references.asv: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and Jehovah hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
public_domain_references.kjv: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
public_domain_references.brenton: All we as sheep have gone astray; every one has gone astray in his way; and the Lord gave him up for our sins.

pob.text: He was oppressed[a], and he was afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth; like a lamb led to the slaughter, and like a ewe silent before her shearers, so he did not open his mouth.

spob.text: He was oppressed and made to suffer,[a] but he did not open his mouth. He was like a lamb being led to slaughter, like a female sheep that is silent while its wool is cut off. In the same way, he did not open his mouth.

public_domain_references.bsb: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
public_domain_references.web: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.
public_domain_references.asv: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he opened not his mouth; as a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is dumb, so he opened not his mouth.
public_domain_references.kjv: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he, because of his affliction, opens not his mouth: he was led as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.

pob.text: By oppression and judgment he was taken away[a]; and as for his generation, who considered that he was cut off from the land of the living[c][b], stricken for the transgression of my people?

spob.text: He was taken away through oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off from the land of the living, stricken for the rebellion of my people?[a][b][c]

public_domain_references.bsb: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, and who can recount His descendants? For He was cut off from the land of the living; He was stricken for the transgression of My people.
public_domain_references.web: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?
public_domain_references.asv: By oppression and judgment he was taken away; and as for his generation, who [among them] considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living for the transgression of my people to whom the stroke [was due]?
public_domain_references.kjv: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
public_domain_references.brenton: In [his] humiliation his judgment was taken away: who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken away from the earth: because of the iniquities of my people he was led to death.

pob.text: And they assigned his grave with the wicked[a], and with a rich man in his deaths, although he had done no violence[b], and no deceit was in his mouth.

spob.text: They designated his burial place among the wicked and with a rich man in his deaths.[a][b] Yet he had committed no violence, and no deceit was in his mouth.

public_domain_references.bsb: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in His death, although He had done no violence, nor was any deceit in His mouth.
public_domain_references.web: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
public_domain_references.asv: And they made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death; although he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither [was any] deceit in his mouth.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will give the wicked for his burial, and the rich for his death; for he practised no iniquity, nor craft with his mouth.

pob.text: Yet it pleased Yahweh to crush him[a]; he made him sick. If his life makes a guilt offering, he will see offspring, he will prolong his days[e][d][c][b], and the pleasure of Yahweh will prosper in his hand.

spob.text: Yet Yahweh was pleased to crush him and make him sick. If his life is made a guilt offering,[a] he will see offspring and live for many days. Yahweh’s purpose will succeed through him.

public_domain_references.bsb: Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand.
public_domain_references.web: Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and Yahweh’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.
public_domain_references.asv: Yet it pleased Jehovah to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see [his] seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Jehovah shall prosper in his hand.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put [him] to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see [his] seed, he shall prolong [his] days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord also is pleased to purge him from his stroke. If ye can give an offering for sin, your soul shall see a long-lived seed:

pob.text: From the anguish of his soul he will see and be satisfied[a]; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many[b], and he will bear their iniquities.

spob.text: From his inner anguish, he will see[a] and be satisfied. Through his knowledge[b], my righteous servant will justify[c] many. He himself will bear their guilt.

public_domain_references.bsb: After the anguish of His soul, He will see the light of life and be satisfied. By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many, and He will bear their iniquities.
public_domain_references.web: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.
public_domain_references.asv: He shall see of the travail of his soul, [and] shall be satisfied: by the knowledge of himself shall my righteous servant justify many; and he shall bear their iniquities.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall see of the travail of his soul, [and] shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
public_domain_references.brenton: the Lord also is pleased to take away from the travail of his soul, to shew him light, and to form [him] with understanding; to justify the just one who serves many well; and he shall bear their sins.

pob.text: Therefore I will allot him a portion among the many[a], and he will divide plunder with the strong, because he poured out his life to death and was numbered with transgressors[c][b]; yet he bore the sin of many and intercedes for transgressors.

spob.text: Therefore, I will give him a share among the many,[a] and he will divide the plunder with the strong. I will do this because he poured out his life, giving himself over to death, and was counted among transgressors.[b] Yet he bore the sin of many and intercedes for transgressors.

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors. Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he poured out his soul unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors: yet he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore will I divide him [a portion] with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore he shall inherit many, and he shall divide the spoils of the mighty; because his soul was delivered to death: and he was numbered among the transgressors; and he bore the sins of many, and was delivered because of their iniquities.

pob.text: Sing[a], barren woman, you who have not given birth; break forth into singing and shout for joy, you who have not been in labor. For the children of the desolate woman are more than the children of the married woman, says Yahweh.

spob.text: Sing, woman unable to have children, you who have not given birth! Burst into song and shout for joy, you who have not been in labor! For the desolate woman has more[a] children than the married woman, says Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: “Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Sing, O barren, thou [that] didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou [that] didst not travail with child: for more [are] the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that dost not travail: for more are the children of the desolate than of her that has a husband: for the Lord has said,

pob.text: Enlarge the place of your tent[a], and let the curtains of your dwellings be stretched out; do not hold back. Lengthen your cords[b], and strengthen your stakes.

spob.text: Make more room for your tent. Stretch out the fabric curtains of your dwelling places; do not hold back. Lengthen your tent ropes, and make your tent stakes firm.

public_domain_references.bsb: “Enlarge the site of your tent, stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep.
public_domain_references.web: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.
public_domain_references.asv: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thy habitations; spare not: lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes.
public_domain_references.kjv: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
public_domain_references.brenton: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and of thy curtains: fix [the pins], spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy pins;

pob.text: For you will spread out to the right and to the left[b][a], and your offspring will possess nations and will settle desolate cities.

spob.text: For you will spread out in every direction—to the right and to the left. Your descendants will take possession of nations, and they will resettle cities that lie deserted.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: For you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities.
public_domain_references.web: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.
public_domain_references.asv: For thou shalt spread abroad on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall possess the nations, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
public_domain_references.kjv: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
public_domain_references.brenton: spread forth [thy tent] yet to the right and the left: for thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and thou shalt make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

pob.text: Do not fear[a], for you will not be put to shame; and do not be humiliated, for you will not be disgraced. For you will forget the shame of your youth[b], and you will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

spob.text: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame. Do not be humiliated, for you will not be disgraced. You will forget the shame of your youth, and you will no longer remember the public disgrace of your widowhood.

public_domain_references.bsb: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
public_domain_references.web: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.
public_domain_references.asv: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth; and the reproach of thy widowhood shalt thou remember no more.
public_domain_references.kjv: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
public_domain_references.brenton: Fear not, because thou hast been put to shame, neither be confounded, because thou wast reproached: for thou shalt forget thy former shame, and shalt no more at all remember the reproach of thy widowhood.

pob.text: For your husband is your Maker[a]; Yahweh of Armies is his name. And your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel[b]; he is called the God of all the earth.

spob.text: For the one who made you is your husband. His name is Yahweh of Armies.[a] The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He is called the God of all the earth.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
public_domain_references.web: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.
public_domain_references.asv: For thy Maker is thy husband; Jehovah of hosts is his name: and the Holy One of Israel is thy Redeemer; the God of the whole earth shall he be called.
public_domain_references.kjv: For thy Maker [is] thine husband; the LORD of hosts [is] his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
public_domain_references.brenton: For [it is] the Lord that made thee; the Lord of hosts is his name: and he that delivered thee, he is the God of Israel, [and] shall be called [so] by the whole earth.

pob.text: For Yahweh has called you like a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit[a], like a wife of youth when she is rejected[b], says your God.

spob.text: For Yahweh has called you like an abandoned wife grieving deep within[a]—like a wife married in her youth when she is rejected[b], says your God.

public_domain_references.bsb: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.
public_domain_references.web: For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.
public_domain_references.asv: For Jehovah hath called thee as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off, saith thy God.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord has not called thee as a deserted and faint-hearted woman, nor as a woman hated from [her] youth, saith thy God.

pob.text: For a brief moment I abandoned you[a], but with great compassion I will gather you.

spob.text: I abandoned you, but only for a short time. With great compassion, I will gather you.

public_domain_references.bsb: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
public_domain_references.web: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.
public_domain_references.asv: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: For a little while I left thee: but with great mercy will I have compassion upon thee.

pob.text: In a surge of wrath I hid my face from you for a moment[a], but with everlasting lovingkindness I have had compassion on you, says Yahweh[b], your Redeemer.

spob.text: In a burst of anger, I turned my face away from you for a moment. But with everlasting covenant love[a], I have shown you compassion, says Yahweh, your Redeemer.

public_domain_references.bsb: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
public_domain_references.web: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.
public_domain_references.asv: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting lovingkindness will I have mercy on thee, saith Jehovah thy Redeemer.
public_domain_references.kjv: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
public_domain_references.brenton: In a little wrath I turned away my face from thee; but with everlasting mercy will I have compassion upon thee, saith the Lord that delivers thee.

pob.text: For this is like the waters of Noah to me: just as I swore that the waters of Noah would never again pass over the earth[a], so I have sworn not to be angry with you and not to rebuke you.

spob.text: For this is like the waters of Noah to me.[a] I swore that those waters would never again sweep over the earth. In the same way, I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.

public_domain_references.bsb: “For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
public_domain_references.web: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.
public_domain_references.asv: For this is [as] the waters of Noah unto me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah shall no more go over the earth, so have I sworn that I will not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: For this [is as] the waters of Noah unto me: for [as] I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: From the time of the water of Noe this is my [purpose]: as I sware to him at that time, [saying] of the earth, I will no more be wroth with thee, neither when thou art threatened,

pob.text: For the mountains may depart and the hills may be shaken[a], but my steadfast love will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be shaken, says Yahweh[c][b], who has compassion on you.

spob.text: “For the mountains could move away, and the hills could be shaken. But my steadfast love[a] will never move away from you, and my covenant of peace[b] will never be shaken,” says Yahweh, who has compassion on you.

public_domain_references.bsb: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
public_domain_references.web: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.
public_domain_references.asv: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my lovingkindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall my covenant of peace be removed, saith Jehovah that hath mercy on thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: shall the mountains depart, nor shall thy hills be removed: so neither shall my mercy fail thee, nor shall the covenant of thy peace be at all removed: for the Lord [who is] gracious to thee has spoken [it].

pob.text: O afflicted one[a], storm-tossed and not comforted, behold[b], I am setting your stones in antimony and laying your foundations with sapphires.

spob.text: You suffering city, battered by storms and without comfort, look: I am setting your stones in a dark mineral called antimony[a] and laying your foundations with sapphires.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
public_domain_references.web: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
public_domain_references.asv: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will set thy stones in fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, [and] not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
public_domain_references.brenton: Afflicted and outcast thou hast not been comforted: behold, I [will] prepare carbuncle [for] thy stones, and sapphire for thy foundations;

pob.text: And I will make your pinnacles of ruby[a], your gates of sparkling stone[d][c][b], and all your boundary walls of precious stones.

spob.text: I will build your pinnacles with ruby[a][b], your gates with stones that sparkle[c], and every boundary wall with precious stones.[d]

public_domain_references.bsb: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
public_domain_references.web: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will make thy pinnacles of rubies, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy border of precious stones.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
public_domain_references.brenton: and I will make thy buttresses jasper, and thy gates crystal, and thy border precious stones.

pob.text: And all your children will be taught by Yahweh[b][a], and great will be the peace of your children.

spob.text: And all your children[a] will be taught by Yahweh, and they will have great peace.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
public_domain_references.web: All your children will be taught by Yahweh, and your children’s peace will be great.
public_domain_references.asv: And all thy children shall be taught of Jehovah; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
public_domain_references.kjv: And all thy children [shall be] taught of the LORD; and great [shall be] the peace of thy children.
public_domain_references.brenton: And [I will cause] all thy sons [to be] taught of God, and thy children [to be] in great peace.

pob.text: In righteousness you will be established[a]; you will be far from oppression, for you will not fear, and from terror[b], for it will not come near you.
