public_domain_references.web: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”
public_domain_references.asv: even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt-offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
public_domain_references.kjv: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices [shall be] accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
public_domain_references.brenton: I will bring them to my holy mountain, and gladden them in my house of prayer: their whole-burnt-offerings and their sacrifices shall be acceptable upon mine altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations,

pob.text: The declaration of the Lord GOD[b][a], who gathers the outcasts of Israel: I will gather still more to him besides those already gathered to him.

spob.text: The Lord Yahweh gathers the people of Israel who were driven away. He declares, “I will gather still more people to him, in addition to those already gathered to him.”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Thus declares the Lord GOD, who gathers the dispersed of Israel: “I will gather to them still others besides those already gathered.”
public_domain_references.web: The Lord Yahweh, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”
public_domain_references.asv: The Lord Jehovah, who gathereth the outcasts of Israel, saith, Yet will I gather [others] to him, besides his own that are gathered.
public_domain_references.kjv: The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather [others] to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
public_domain_references.brenton: saith the Lord that gathers the dispersed of Israel; for I will gather to him a congregation.

pob.text: All you beasts of the field[b][a], come to devour— all you beasts of the forest.

spob.text: Come and devour, all you beasts of the field,[a][b] all you beasts in the forest!

public_domain_references.bsb: Come, all you beasts of the field; eat greedily, all you beasts of the forest.
public_domain_references.web: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.
public_domain_references.asv: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, [yea], all ye beasts in the forest.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, [yea], all ye beasts in the forest.
public_domain_references.brenton: All ye beasts of the field, come, devour, all ye beasts of the forest.

pob.text: His watchmen are blind[a], all of them; they know nothing. All of them are mute dogs, unable to bark, dreamers, lying down, loving to slumber.

spob.text: His watchmen are all blind. They know nothing. They are all mute dogs that cannot bark. They dream, lie down, and love to sleep.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they are all oblivious; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they are dreamers lying around, loving to slumber.
public_domain_references.web: His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.
public_domain_references.asv: His watchmen are blind, they are all without knowledge; they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.
public_domain_references.kjv: His watchmen [are] blind: they are all ignorant, they [are] all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
public_domain_references.brenton: See how they are all blinded: they have not known; [they are] dumb dogs [that] will not bark; dreaming of rest, loving to slumber.

pob.text: And the dogs are greedy in appetite[a]; they do not know satisfaction. And they are shepherds who do not know understanding; all of them have turned to their own way, each one to his own gain[c][b], every one without exception.

spob.text: The dogs have greedy appetites; they never have enough. They are shepherds who understand nothing. They have all turned to their own way. Each one seeks his own dishonest gain—every one of them, without exception.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Like ravenous dogs, they are never satisfied. They are shepherds with no discernment; they all turn to their own way, each one seeking his own gain:
public_domain_references.web: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.
public_domain_references.asv: Yea, the dogs are greedy, they can never have enough; and these are shepherds that cannot understand: they have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yea, [they are] greedy dogs [which] can never have enough, and they [are] shepherds [that] cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
public_domain_references.brenton: Yea, they are insatiable dogs, that know not what it is to be filled, and they are wicked, having no understanding: all have followed their own ways, each according to his own [will].

pob.text: Come[a], let me get wine, and let us fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be like this day[b], great beyond measure.

spob.text: Come, let me get some wine, and let us drink our fill of strong drink. Tomorrow will be just like today, only far greater.

public_domain_references.bsb: “Come, let me get the wine, let us imbibe the strong drink, and tomorrow will be like today, only far better!”
public_domain_references.web: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”
public_domain_references.asv: Come ye, [say they], I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to-morrow shall be as this day, [a day] great beyond measure.
public_domain_references.kjv: Come ye, [say they], I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, [and] much more abundant.

pob.text: The righteous man perishes[a], and no one takes it to heart; men of faithful love are gathered away, with no one understanding that the righteous man is gathered away because of evil.

spob.text: A righteous man perishes, and no one takes it to heart. Men who live with faithful love are gathered away in death, but no one understands that the righteous man has been gathered away from evil.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; devout men are swept away, while no one considers that the righteous are guided from the presence of evil.
public_domain_references.web: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.
public_domain_references.asv: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart; and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil [to come].
public_domain_references.kjv: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth [it] to heart: and merciful men [are] taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil [to come].
public_domain_references.brenton: See how the just man has perished, and no one lays [it] to heart: and righteous men are taken away, and no one considers: for the righteous has been removed out of the way of injustice.

pob.text: He enters into peace[a]; they rest on their beds[c][b], each one who walks in his uprightness.

spob.text: He enters into peace.[a] They rest on their beds—each one who walked uprightly.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest, lying down in death.
public_domain_references.web: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.
public_domain_references.asv: He entereth into peace; they rest in their beds, each one that walketh in his uprightness.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, [each one] walking [in] his uprightness.
public_domain_references.brenton: His burial shall be in peace: he has been removed out of the way.

pob.text: But you—come here[a], sons of a sorceress[b], offspring of an adulterer and a prostitute.

spob.text: But you, come here! You are sons of a woman who practices sorcery, offspring of an adulterous man and a prostitute.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: “But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
public_domain_references.web: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
public_domain_references.asv: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the harlot.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
public_domain_references.brenton: But draw ye near hither, ye lawless children, the seed of adulterers and the harlot.

pob.text: At whom do you sport yourselves? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression[c][b][a], offspring of deceit?

spob.text: Whom are you mocking? Whom are you insulting by opening your mouth wide and sticking out your tongue? Are you not children of rebellion, offspring of deceit?[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Whom are you mocking? At whom do you snarl and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of deceit,
public_domain_references.web: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,
public_domain_references.asv: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and put out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
public_domain_references.kjv: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, [and] draw out the tongue? [are] ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
public_domain_references.brenton: Wherein have ye been rioting? and against whom have ye opened your mouth, and against whom have ye loosed your tongue? are ye not children of perdition? a lawless seed?

pob.text: you who burn with lust among the terebinths[a], under every green tree, who slaughter the children in the wadis[b], under the clefts of the rocks.

spob.text: You burn with lust among terebinth trees used for worship,[a] under every green tree. You slaughter children in ravines,[b] beneath clefts in the rocks.

public_domain_references.bsb: who burn with lust among the oaks, under every luxuriant tree, who slaughter your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
public_domain_references.web: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
public_domain_references.asv: ye that inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; that slay the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
public_domain_references.kjv: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
public_domain_references.brenton: who call upon idols under the leafy trees, slaying your children in the valleys among the rocks?

pob.text: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion[a]; they, they are your lot. Even to them you have poured out a drink offering; you have offered up a grain offering[b]. Shall I relent because of these things?

spob.text: Among the smooth stones in the valley is your portion[a]—yes, they are your allotted share. You have even poured out a drink as an offering to them and presented grain as an offering to them. Should I relent because of these things?[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Your portion is among the smooth stones of the valley; indeed, they are your lot. Even to them you have poured out a drink offering and offered a grain offering. Should I relent because of these?
public_domain_references.web: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?
public_domain_references.asv: Among the smooth [stones] of the valley is thy portion; they, they are thy lot; even to them hast thou poured a drink-offering, thou hast offered an oblation. Shall I be appeased for these things?
public_domain_references.kjv: Among the smooth [stones] of the stream [is] thy portion; they, they [are] thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
public_domain_references.brenton: That is thy portion, this is thy lot: and to them hast thou poured forth drink-offerings, and to these hast thou offered meat-offerings. Shall I not therefore be angry for these things?

pob.text: On a high and lofty mountain you set your bed[b][a]; there too you went up to sacrifice a sacrifice.

spob.text: On a high, lofty mountain, you placed your bed.[a] You also went up there to offer sacrifice.

public_domain_references.bsb: On a high and lofty hill you have made your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifices.
public_domain_references.web: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
public_domain_references.asv: Upon a high and lofty mountain hast thou set thy bed; thither also wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
public_domain_references.kjv: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
public_domain_references.brenton: On a lofty and high mountain, there is thy bed, and thither thou carriedst up thy meat-offerings:

pob.text: Behind the door and the doorpost you set up your memorial[a]; for away from me you uncovered yourself and went up; you made your bed wide, and you made a covenant for yourself with them; you loved their bed[c][b]; you looked on a hand.

spob.text: Behind the door and the doorpost, you set up your memorial symbol.[a] For you uncovered yourself, turning away from me, and went up. You made your bed wider and made a covenant for yourself with them.[b] You loved their bed. You gazed at a hand.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: Behind the door and doorpost you have set up your memorial. Forsaking Me, you uncovered your bed; you climbed up and opened it wide. And you have made a pact with those whose bed you have loved; you have gazed upon their nakedness.
public_domain_references.web: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.
public_domain_references.asv: And behind the doors and the posts hast thou set up thy memorial: for thou hast uncovered [thyself] to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them: thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered [thyself to another] than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee [a covenant] with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest [it].
public_domain_references.brenton: and behind the posts of thy door thou didst place thy memorials. Didst thou think that if thou shouldest depart from me, thou wouldest gain? thou hast loved those that lay with thee;

pob.text: You journeyed to the king with oil[a], and multiplied your perfumes; you sent your envoys far away[b], and debased yourself even to Sheol.

spob.text: You traveled to the king[a] with oil and more and more perfume. You sent your envoys far away, and you degraded yourself all the way down to Sheol.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: You went to Molech with oil and multiplied your perfumes. You have sent your envoys a great distance; you have descended even to Sheol itself.
public_domain_references.web: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou wentest to the king with oil, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thine ambassadors far off, and didst debase thyself even unto Sheol.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase [thyself even] unto hell.
public_domain_references.brenton: and thou hast multiplied thy whoredom with them, and thou hast increased the number of them that are far from thee, and hast sent ambassadors beyond thy borders, and hast been debased even to hell.

pob.text: In the multitude of your ways you grew weary[a], yet you did not say, ‘It is hopeless.’ You found renewed strength in your hand[c][b]; therefore you did not grow weak.

spob.text: Your many pursuits wore you out, but you did not say, “It is hopeless.” You found renewed strength in your hand[a], so you did not give out.

public_domain_references.bsb: You are wearied by your many journeys, but you did not say, “There is no hope!” You found renewal of your strength; therefore you did not grow weak.
public_domain_references.web: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou wast wearied with the length of thy way; yet saidst thou not, It is in vain: thou didst find a quickening of thy strength; therefore thou wast not faint.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; [yet] saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou hast wearied thyself with thy many ways; yet thou saidst not, I will cease to strengthen myself: for thou hast done these things; therefore thou hast not supplicated me.

pob.text: And whom did you dread and fear[a], so that you lied and did not remember me, did not lay it to your heart? Was it not because I have kept silent, and that from long ago[b], that you do not fear me?

spob.text: Who did you dread and fear so much that you lied? You did not remember me or take it to heart. Was it not because I have kept silent for so long that you do not fear me?

public_domain_references.bsb: Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lied and failed to remember Me or take this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear Me?
public_domain_references.web: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?
public_domain_references.asv: And of whom hast thou been afraid and in fear, that thou liest, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of long time, and thou fearest me not?
public_domain_references.kjv: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid [it] to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
public_domain_references.brenton: Through dread of whom hast thou feared, and lied against me, and hast not remembered, nor considered me, nor regarded me, yea, though when I see thee I pass thee by, yet thou hast not feared me.

pob.text: I myself will declare your righteousness and your works[b][a], but they will not profit you.

spob.text: I myself will make known your righteousness[a] and what you have done, but none of it will help you.

public_domain_references.bsb: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not profit you.
public_domain_references.web: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.
public_domain_references.asv: I will declare thy righteousness; and as for thy works, they shall not profit thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will declare thy righteousness, and thy sins, which shall not profit thee.

pob.text: When you cry out[a], let your gathered idols rescue you! But the wind will carry all of them off; a breath will take them away[c][b]. But whoever takes refuge in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain.

spob.text: When you cry for help, tell all the idols you have gathered to save you![a] The wind will sweep every one of them away; a breath will blow them away. But whoever finds shelter in me will inherit the land[b] and possess my holy mountain.

public_domain_references.bsb: When you cry out, let your companies of idols deliver you! Yet the wind will carry off all of them, a breath will take them away. But he who seeks refuge in Me will inherit the land and possess My holy mountain.”
public_domain_references.web: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”
public_domain_references.asv: When thou criest, let them that thou hast gathered deliver thee; but the wind shall take them, a breath shall carry them all away: but he that taketh refuge in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take [them:] but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
public_domain_references.brenton: When thou criest out, let them deliver thee in thine affliction: for all these the wind shall take, and the tempest shall carry [them] away: but they that cleave to me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain.

pob.text: And it will be said[a], “Build up, build up; clear the way; remove the stumbling block from the way of my people.”

spob.text: Then it will be said,[a] “Build up the road—build it up! Clear the way! Remove the stumbling block from my people’s path.”

public_domain_references.bsb: And it will be said, “Build it up, build it up, prepare the way, take every obstacle out of the way of My people.”
public_domain_references.web: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”
public_domain_references.asv: And he will say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.
public_domain_references.kjv: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall say, Clear the ways before him, and take up the stumbling-blocks out of the way of my people.

pob.text: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up[a], who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in the high and holy place, and also with the crushed and lowly in spirit[b], to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the crushed.”

spob.text:
For this is what the One who is high and lifted up says, the One who lives in eternity[a] and whose name is Holy:

“I live in the high and holy place, but I also live with those who are crushed[b] and lowly in spirit. I revive the spirits of the lowly and the hearts of those who are crushed.”

public_domain_references.bsb: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
public_domain_references.web: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
public_domain_references.asv: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
public_domain_references.kjv: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name [is] Holy; I dwell in the high and holy [place], with him also [that is] of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thus saith the Most High, who dwells on high for ever, Holy in the holies, is his name, the Most High resting in the holies, and giving patience to the faint-hearted, and giving life to the broken-hearted:

pob.text: For I will not contend forever[a], nor will I be angry without end, for the spirit would grow faint before me[b], and the breaths that I have made.

spob.text: For I will not keep contending with them forever or remain angry without end. Otherwise, the human spirit[a] would grow faint before me, and the breaths of life that I have made would fail.

public_domain_references.bsb: For I will not accuse you forever, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me, with the breath of those I have made.
public_domain_references.web: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
public_domain_references.asv: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls that I have made.
public_domain_references.kjv: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls [which] I have made.
public_domain_references.brenton: I will not take vengeance on you for ever, neither will I be always angry with you: for my Spirit shall go forth from me, and I have created all breath.

pob.text: Because of the iniquity of his unjust gain I was angry[a], and I struck him; I hid myself and was angry[b], and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

spob.text: I was angry because of his sinful, unjust gain.[a] I struck him and hid myself from him in anger.[b] And he kept turning away, following the path of his own heart.

public_domain_references.bsb: I was enraged by his sinful greed, so I struck him and hid My face in anger; yet he kept turning back to the desires of his heart.
public_domain_references.web: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
public_domain_references.asv: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him; I hid [my face] and was wroth; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
public_domain_references.brenton: On account of sin for a little while I grieved him, and smote him, and turned away my face from him; and he was grieved, and he went on sorrowful in his ways.

pob.text: I have seen his ways[a], and I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

spob.text: I have seen how he has lived, but I will heal him. I will lead him and give comfort again to him and to those who mourn for him.

public_domain_references.bsb: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comfort to him and his mourners,
public_domain_references.web: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
public_domain_references.asv: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
public_domain_references.kjv: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
public_domain_references.brenton: I have seen his ways, and healed him, and comforted him, and given him true comfort;

pob.text: Creating the fruit of the lips: Peace[a], peace to the one far off and to the one near, says Yahweh[c][b], and I will heal him.

spob.text: “I create the fruit of the lips—what lips produce. ‘Peace, peace to the one far away and to the one near,’ says Yahweh, ‘and I will heal him.’”

public_domain_references.bsb: bringing praise to their lips. Peace, peace to those far and near,” says the LORD, “and I will heal them.”
public_domain_references.web: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will heal them.”

spob.text: Their feet run toward evil, and they rush to spill the blood of innocent people. They think wicked thoughts.[a] Devastation and destruction are found on their roads.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Their feet run to evil; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are sinful thoughts; ruin and destruction lie in their wake.
public_domain_references.web: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.
public_domain_references.asv: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.
public_domain_references.kjv: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts [are] thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction [are] in their paths.
public_domain_references.brenton: And their feet run to wickedness, swift to shed blood; their thoughts also are thoughts of murder; destruction and misery are in their ways;

pob.text: They do not know the way of peace[a], and there is no justice in their paths; they have made their roads crooked for themselves[b]; everyone who walks in them does not know peace.

spob.text: They do not know how to live in peace. There is no justice in the paths they follow.[a] They have made their own roads crooked. Anyone who follows those roads does not know peace.

public_domain_references.bsb: The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.
public_domain_references.web: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.
public_domain_references.asv: The way of peace they know not; and there is no justice in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein doth not know peace.
public_domain_references.kjv: The way of peace they know not; and [there is] no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
public_domain_references.brenton: and the way of peace they know not, neither is there judgment in their ways; for their paths by which they go are crooked, and they know not peace.

pob.text: Therefore justice is far from us[a], and righteousness does not overtake us; we hope for light, but look—darkness; for brightness[c][b], but we walk in deep gloom.

spob.text: That is why justice remains far from us, and righteousness does not catch up with us. We hope for light, but look—there is only darkness. We hope for brightness, but we walk in deep gloom.

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We hope for light, but there is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in gloom.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore is justice far from us, neither doth righteousness overtake us: we look for light, but, behold, darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, [but] we walk in darkness.
public_domain_references.brenton: Therefore has judgment departed from them, and righteousness shall not overtake them: while they waited for light, darkness came upon them; while they waited for brightness, they walked in perplexity.

pob.text: We grope for the wall like the blind; like those without eyes we grope[a]. We stumble at noon as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.

spob.text: Like blind people, we feel along the wall. We keep feeling our way as if we had no eyes. Even at noon, we stumble as though it were twilight. Among vigorous people,[a] we are like the dead.

public_domain_references.bsb: Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
public_domain_references.web: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.
public_domain_references.asv: We grope for the wall like the blind; yea, we grope as they that have no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the twilight; among them that are lusty we are as dead men.
public_domain_references.kjv: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if [we had] no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; [we are] in desolate places as dead [men].
public_domain_references.brenton: They shall feel for the wall as blind [men], and shall feel [for it] as if they had no eyes: and they shall feel at noon-day as at midnight; they shall groan as dying men.

pob.text: We all growl like bears[a], and like doves we moan continually; we hope for justice, but there is none; for salvation[b], but it is far from us.

spob.text: We all growl like bears and keep moaning like doves. We hope for justice,[a] but there is none. We hope for salvation,[b] but it remains far from us.

public_domain_references.bsb: We all growl like bears and moan like doves. We hope for justice, but find none, for salvation, but it is far from us.
public_domain_references.web: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.
public_domain_references.asv: We roar all like bears, and moan sore like doves: we look for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
public_domain_references.kjv: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but [there is] none; for salvation, [but] it is far off from us.
public_domain_references.brenton: They shall proceed together as a bear and as a dove: we have waited for judgment, and there is no salvation, it is gone far from us.

pob.text: For our transgressions are many before you[a], and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and we know our iniquities.

spob.text: For our acts of rebellion are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. For our acts of rebellion remain with us, and we know our own wrongdoing.

public_domain_references.bsb: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
public_domain_references.web: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
public_domain_references.asv: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
public_domain_references.kjv: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions [are] with us; and [as for] our iniquities, we know them;
public_domain_references.brenton: For our iniquity is great before thee, and our sins have risen up against us: for our iniquities are in us, and we know our unrighteous deeds.

pob.text: transgressing and denying Yahweh[a], and turning back from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt[b], conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

spob.text: We sin against and deny Yahweh, and we turn away from following our God. We speak words that oppress others and call for revolt.[a] In our hearts we plan lies and then speak them.

public_domain_references.bsb: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.
public_domain_references.web: transgressing and denying Yahweh, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
public_domain_references.asv: transgressing and denying Jehovah, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
public_domain_references.kjv: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
public_domain_references.brenton: We have sinned, and dealt falsely, and revolted from our God: we have spoken unrighteous words, and have been disobedient; we have conceived and uttered from our heart unrighteous words.

pob.text: Justice is turned back[a], and righteousness stands far off; for truth has stumbled in the street[b], and uprightness cannot enter.

spob.text: Justice has been driven back, and righteousness stands far away. This is because truth has stumbled in the public square,[a] and what is right cannot enter.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: So justice is turned away, and righteousness stands at a distance. For truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.
public_domain_references.web: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.
public_domain_references.asv: And justice is turned away backward, and righteousness standeth afar off; for truth is fallen in the street, and uprightness cannot enter.
public_domain_references.kjv: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
public_domain_references.brenton: And we have turned judgment back, and righteousness has departed afar off: for truth is consumed in their ways, and they could not pass by a straight [path].

pob.text: So truth was missing[a], and whoever turned away from evil was plundered. Yahweh saw[b], and it was evil in his eyes that there was no justice.

spob.text: Truth could not be found. Anyone who turned away from evil was plundered.[a] Yahweh saw that there was no justice, and he judged this to be evil.

public_domain_references.bsb: Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.
public_domain_references.web: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Yahweh saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
public_domain_references.asv: Yea, truth is lacking; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey. And Jehovah saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yea, truth faileth; and he [that] departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw [it], and it displeased him that [there was] no judgment.
public_domain_references.brenton: And truth has been taken away, and they have turned aside [their] mind from understanding. And the Lord saw it, and it pleased him not that there was no judgment.

pob.text: He saw that there was no man[a], and he was appalled that there was no one to intercede; so his own arm brought him salvation[c][b], and his righteousness upheld him.

spob.text: He saw that there was no man[a] to act, and he was appalled that there was no one to step in for another. So his own arm—his own power—brought him salvation, and his righteousness[b] upheld him.

public_domain_references.bsb: He saw that there was no man; He was amazed that there was no one to intercede. So His own arm brought salvation, and His own righteousness sustained Him.
public_domain_references.web: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.
public_domain_references.asv: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his own arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it upheld him.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And he saw that [there was] no man, and wondered that [there was] no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he looked, and there was no man, and he observed, and there was none to help: so he defended them with his arm, and stablished [them] with [his] mercy.

pob.text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate[a], and a helmet of salvation on his head; he put on garments of vengeance for clothing[c][b], and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.

spob.text: He put on righteousness as body armor[a] and placed the helmet of salvation[b] on his head. He dressed in garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal[c] like a cloak.

public_domain_references.bsb: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.
public_domain_references.web: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.
public_domain_references.asv: And he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.
public_domain_references.kjv: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance [for] clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he put on righteousness as a breast-plate, and placed the helmet of salvation on his head; and he clothed himself with the garment of vengeance, and with his cloak,

pob.text: According to their deeds[a], so he will repay: wrath to his adversaries, repayment to his enemies; to the coastlands he will repay what is due.

spob.text: He will repay them according to what they have done. His adversaries will face his wrath, and his enemies will receive their punishment. He will repay the distant coastlands[a] with what they deserve.

public_domain_references.bsb: So He will repay according to their deeds: fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, and recompense to the islands.
public_domain_references.web: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.
public_domain_references.asv: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompense.
public_domain_references.kjv: According to [their] deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
public_domain_references.brenton: as one about to render a recompence, [even] reproach to his adversaries.

pob.text: So they will fear the name of Yahweh from the west[a], and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come like a rushing river[c][b], driven by the breath of Yahweh.

spob.text: So people in the west will fear Yahweh’s name, and people where the sun rises[a] will fear his glory. For Yahweh will come like a rushing river that is driven by his breath.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: So shall they fear the name of the LORD where the sun sets, and His glory where it rises. For He will come like a raging flood, driven by the breath of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: So they will fear Yahweh’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which Yahweh’s breath drives.
public_domain_references.asv: So shall they fear the name of Jehovah from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the breath of Jehovah driveth.
public_domain_references.kjv: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
public_domain_references.brenton: So shall they of the west fear the name of the Lord, and they [that come] from the rising of the sun his glorious name: for the wrath of the Lord shall come as a mighty river, it shall come with fury.

pob.text: And a Redeemer will come to Zion[a], and to those in Jacob who turn from transgression[d][c][b], declares Yahweh.

spob.text: A Redeemer[a] will come to Zion and to those among Jacob’s people who turn away from rebellion, declares Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression,” declares the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: And a Redeemer will come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the deliverer shall come for Sion's sake, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

pob.text: And as for me[a], this is my covenant with them, says Yahweh: my Spirit that is upon you, and my words that I have put in your mouth, shall not depart from your mouth, or from the mouth of your offspring, or from the mouth of your offspring’s offspring, says Yahweh[b], from now and forever.

spob.text: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit is upon you, and I have put my words in your mouth. Neither my Spirit nor my words will ever depart from your mouth, from the mouths of your descendants, or from the mouths of their descendants, from now and forever,” says Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: “As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says Yahweh, “from now on and forever.”
public_domain_references.asv: And as for me, this is my covenant with them, saith Jehovah: my Spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith Jehovah, from henceforth and for ever.
public_domain_references.kjv: As for me, this [is] my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that [is] upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
public_domain_references.brenton: And this shall be my covenant with them, said the Lord; My Spirit which is upon thee, and the words which I have put in thy mouth, shall never fail from thy mouth, nor from the mouth of thy seed, for the Lord has spoken it, henceforth and for ever.

pob.text: Arise[a], shine, for your light has come[b], and the glory of Yahweh has risen upon you.

spob.text: Rise! Shine, because your light has come. Yahweh’s glory has risen over you.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
public_domain_references.web: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you!
public_domain_references.asv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Jehovah is risen upon thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: Be enlightened, be enlightened, O Jerusalem, for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

pob.text: For look, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will rise upon you, and his glory will appear over you.

spob.text: Look! Darkness will cover the earth, and deep darkness will cover its peoples. But the LORD will rise over you, and his glory will be seen over you.

public_domain_references.bsb: For behold, darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness is over the peoples; but the LORD will rise upon you, and His glory will appear over you.
public_domain_references.web: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but Yahweh will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.
public_domain_references.asv: For, behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the peoples; but Jehovah will arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and [there shall be] gross darkness on the nations: but the Lord shall appear upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

pob.text: Nations will come to your light[c][b][a], and kings to the brightness of your rising.

spob.text: Nations will come to your light, and kings will come to the brightness of your dawn.

public_domain_references.bsb: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
public_domain_references.web: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
public_domain_references.asv: And nations shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
public_domain_references.brenton: And kings shall walk in thy light, and nations in thy brightness.

pob.text: Lift up your eyes all around and see[a]; all of them gather together; they come to you. Your sons will come from far away[b], and your daughters will be carried on the hip.

public_domain_references.web: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

public_domain_references.brenton: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold thy children gathered: all thy sons have come from far, and thy daughters shall be borne on [men's] shoulders.

pob.text: Then you will see and be radiant[a], and your heart will tremble and swell, because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you[b]; the wealth of the nations will come to you.

spob.text: Then you will see and shine with joy. Your heart will tremble and swell, because the sea’s abundance will be turned to you[a], and the wealth of the nations will come to you.

public_domain_references.web: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.

public_domain_references.kjv: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: Then shalt thou see, and fear, and be amazed in thine heart; for the wealth of the sea shall come round to thee, and of nations and peoples; and herds of camels shall come to thee,

pob.text: A multitude of camels will cover you[a], the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all of them will come from Sheba. They will carry gold and frankincense[b], and they will proclaim the praises of Yahweh.

spob.text: A vast number of camels will cover you—young camels from Midian and Ephah. They will all come from Sheba, carrying gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of Yahweh.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall proclaim the praises of Jehovah.

public_domain_references.brenton: and the camels of Madiam and Gæpha shall cover thee: all from Saba shall come bearing gold, and shall bring frankincense, and they shall publish the salvation of the Lord.

pob.text: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you[a]; the rams of Nebaioth will minister to you. They will go up with acceptance on my altar[b], and I will beautify my glorious house.

spob.text: All Kedar’s flocks will be gathered to you, and Nebaioth’s rams will serve you. They will go up onto my altar as offerings I accept, and I will make my glorious temple beautiful.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you and go up on My altar with acceptance; I will adorn My glorious house.
public_domain_references.web: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.
public_domain_references.asv: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee; they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar; and I will glorify the house of my glory.
public_domain_references.kjv: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
public_domain_references.brenton: And all the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered, and the rams of Nabæoth shall come; and acceptable sacrifices shall be offered on my altar, and my house of prayer shall be glorified.

pob.text: Who are these that fly like a cloud[a], and like doves to their windows?

spob.text: Who are these flying like a cloud, like doves flying to their windows?[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves to their shelters?
public_domain_references.web: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
public_domain_references.asv: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

pob.text: Surely the coastlands wait for me[a], and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, with their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel[b], because he has glorified you.

public_domain_references.web: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.

public_domain_references.web: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
public_domain_references.asv: I will greatly rejoice in Jehovah, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with a garland, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
public_domain_references.kjv: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh [himself] with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth [herself] with her jewels.
public_domain_references.brenton: and they shall greatly rejoice in the Lord. Let my soul rejoice in the Lord; for he has clothed me with the robe of salvation, and the garment of joy: he has put a mitre on me as on a bridegroom, and adorned me with ornaments as a bride.

pob.text: For as the earth brings forth its growth[a], and as a garden causes what is sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

spob.text: For just as the earth produces new growth, and a garden makes what is planted there sprout, so the Lord GOD will make righteousness[a] and praise spring up for all nations to see.

public_domain_references.bsb: For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
public_domain_references.web: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord Yahweh will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
public_domain_references.asv: For as the earth bringeth forth its bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord Jehovah will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
public_domain_references.kjv: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
public_domain_references.brenton: And as the earth putting forth her flowers, and as a garden its seed; so shall the Lord, [even] the Lord, cause righteousness to spring forth, and exultation before all nations.

pob.text: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent[a], and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not be quiet[c][b], until her righteousness goes out like brightness and her salvation burns like a torch.

spob.text: For Zion’s sake, I will not keep silent;[a] for Jerusalem’s sake, I will not be quiet,[b] until her righteousness[c] shines out like a bright light and her salvation burns like a torch.

public_domain_references.bsb: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep still, until her righteousness shines like a bright light, her salvation like a blazing torch.
public_domain_references.web: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.
public_domain_references.asv: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a lamp that burneth.
public_domain_references.kjv: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp [that] burneth.
public_domain_references.brenton: For Sion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as light, and my salvation burn as a torch.

pob.text: Nations will see your righteousness[a], and all kings your glory[b]; and you will be called by a new name that the mouth of Yahweh will designate.

spob.text: The nations will see your righteousness,[a] and all kings will see your glory. You will be called by a new name that Yahweh himself will designate.

public_domain_references.bsb: Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
public_domain_references.web: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which Yahweh’s mouth will name.
public_domain_references.asv: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory, and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of Jehovah shall name.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and kings thy glory: and one shall call thee [by] a new name, which the Lord shall name.

pob.text: You will be a crown of beauty in the hand of Yahweh[a], and a royal turban in the palm of your God.

spob.text: You will be a crown of beauty that Yahweh holds in his hand, and a royal turban[a] that your God holds in his palm.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
public_domain_references.web: You will also be a crown of beauty in Yahweh’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt also be a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

pob.text: No longer will you be called Forsaken[a], and your land will no longer be called Desolate; but you will be called My Delight Is in Her, and your land Married; for Yahweh delights in you[b], and your land will be married.

spob.text: You will no longer be called “Forsaken,” and your land will no longer be called “Desolate.” Instead, you will be called “My Delight Is in Her,”[a] and your land will be called “Married.”[b] For Yahweh delights in you, and your land will be married.

public_domain_references.bsb: No longer will you be called Forsaken, nor your land named Desolate; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be His bride.
public_domain_references.web: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for Yahweh delights in you, and your land will be married.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah; for Jehovah delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt no more be called Forsaken; and thy land shall no more be called Desert: for thou shalt be called My Pleasure, and thy land Inhabited: for the Lord has taken pleasure in thee, and thy land shall be inhabited.

pob.text: For as a young man marries a virgin[a], so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over a bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ For [as] a young man marrieth a virgin, [so] shall thy sons marry thee: and [as] the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, [so] shall thy God rejoice over thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And as a young man lives with a virgin, so shall thy sons dwell in [thee]: and it shall come to pass [that] as a bridegroom will rejoice over a bride, so will the Lord rejoice over thee.

pob.text: On your walls[a], Jerusalem, I have appointed watchmen; all day and all night, continually, they will never be silent. You who remind Yahweh, take no rest for yourselves,

spob.text: Jerusalem, I have stationed watchmen on your walls. They will never be silent, day or night. You who keep reminding Yahweh,[a] give yourselves no rest.

public_domain_references.bsb: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD shall take no rest for yourselves,

public_domain_references.kjv: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, [which] shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
public_domain_references.brenton: And on thy walls, O Jerusalem, have I set watchmen all day and all night, who shall never cease making mention of the Lord.

pob.text: and give him no rest until he establishes and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth[a][b].

spob.text: Keep appealing to the LORD, and give him no rest until he firmly establishes Jerusalem and makes it praised throughout the earth.[a][b]

public_domain_references.kjv: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
public_domain_references.brenton: For there is none like you, when he shall have established, and made Jerusalem a praise on the earth.

pob.text: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand and by his strong arm: I will never again give your grain as food for your enemies[c][b][a], nor will foreigners drink your new wine for which you have labored.

spob.text: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand and his strong arm: “I will never again hand over your grain for your enemies to eat. Foreigners will not drink the new wine you worked to produce.”

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain to your enemies for food, nor will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,

public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn [to be] meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
public_domain_references.brenton: For the Lord has sworn by his glory, and by the might of his arm, I will no more give thy corn and thy provisions to thine enemies; nor shall strangers any more drink thy wine, for which thou hast laboured.

pob.text: But those who gather it will eat it and praise Yahweh[b][a], and those who collect it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.

spob.text: But[a] those who harvest the grain will eat it and praise Yahweh, and those who collect the wine will drink it in the courtyards of my sanctuary.

pob.text: Pass through[a], pass through the gates; clear the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway; clear it of stones[c][b]. Raise up a banner over the peoples.

spob.text: Go through the gates—go through them! Clear a way for the people. Build the highway—build it up! Remove its stones. Raise a banner over the peoples.

public_domain_references.web: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.

public_domain_references.brenton: Go through my gates, and make a way for my people; and cast the stones out of the way; lift up a standard for the Gentiles.

pob.text: Behold[a], Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth: Say to Daughter Zion, “Behold, your salvation comes; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.”

spob.text: See! Yahweh has announced this to the farthest part of the earth: Tell Daughter Zion[a], “See, your salvation[b] is coming! See, his reward is with him, and his payment is before him.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
public_domain_references.web: Behold, Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”

pob.text: And they will call them[a], “The holy people, the redeemed of Yahweh”; and you will be called, “Sought Out[c][b], a city not forsaken.”

spob.text: People will call them “the holy people, those Yahweh has redeemed.” And you will be called “Sought After,[a] a city that is not abandoned.”

public_domain_references.bsb: And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
public_domain_references.web: They will call them “The Holy People, Yahweh’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.
public_domain_references.asv: And they shall call them The holy people, The redeemed of Jehovah: and thou shalt be called Sought out, A city not forsaken.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
public_domain_references.brenton: And one shall call them the holy people, the redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called a city sought out, and not forsaken.

pob.text: Who is this coming from Edom[a], with crimson garments from Bozrah—this one splendid in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? It is I, speaking in righteousness[c][b], mighty to save.

spob.text:
Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with garments colored crimson?[a] Who is this, splendidly dressed and marching with great strength?[b]

“It is I. I speak righteously,[c] and I am mighty to save.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah with crimson-stained garments? Who is this robed in splendor, marching in the greatness of His strength? “It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.”
public_domain_references.web: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

public_domain_references.kjv: Who [is] this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this [that is] glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
public_domain_references.brenton: Who is this that is come from Edom, [with] red garments from Bosor? thus fair in his apparel, with mighty strength? I speak of righteousness and saving judgment.

pob.text: Why is your clothing red[b][a], and your garments like one who treads in the winepress?

spob.text: Why are your clothes red,[a] like the clothes of someone stomping grapes in a winepress?

public_domain_references.bsb: Why are Your clothes red, and Your garments like one who treads the winepress?
public_domain_references.web: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winevat?
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore [art thou] red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
public_domain_references.brenton: Wherefore are thy garments red, and thy raiment as [if fresh] from a trodden wine-press?

pob.text: I have trodden the winepress alone[a], and from the peoples no man was with me; I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath; their lifeblood spattered on my garments[b], and I stained all my clothing.

spob.text: I alone trod the winepress,[a] and no man from the peoples was with me.[b] In my anger I trod them, and in my wrath I trampled them. Their lifeblood splashed onto my garments,[c] and I stained all my clothes.

public_domain_references.kjv: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people [there was] none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
public_domain_references.brenton: I am full of trodden [grape], and of the nations there is not a man with me; and I trampled them in my fury, and dashed them to pieces as earth, and brought down their blood to the earth.

pob.text: For the day of vengeance was in my heart[a], and the year of my redeemed had come.

public_domain_references.brenton: For the day of recompence has come upon them, and the year of redemption is at hand.

pob.text: I looked[a], but there was no one to help; I was appalled, but there was no one to support. So my own arm brought me salvation[b], and my wrath—it upheld me.

spob.text: I looked, but no one was there to help me. I was appalled; no one was there to support me. So my own arm brought me deliverance,[a] and my wrath held me up.

public_domain_references.bsb: I looked, but there was no one to help; I was appalled that no one assisted. So My arm brought Me salvation, and My own wrath upheld Me.
public_domain_references.web: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.

public_domain_references.brenton: And I looked, and there was no helper; and I observed, and none upheld: therefore my arm delivered them, and mine anger drew nigh.

pob.text: I trampled peoples in my anger[a]; I made them drunk in my wrath[b], and I brought their lifeblood down to the earth.

spob.text: In my anger I trampled peoples underfoot.[a] In my wrath I made them drunk and sent their lifeblood pouring onto the ground.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: I trampled the nations in My anger; in My wrath I made them drunk and poured out their blood on the ground.”
public_domain_references.web: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

pob.text: I will recount the steadfast love of Yahweh[a], the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has bestowed on us[c][b], and the great goodness to the house of Israel that he has bestowed on them according to his compassion and according to the abundance of his steadfast love.

spob.text: I will tell of Yahweh’s steadfast love[a] and the praiseworthy things he has done.[b] I will tell of all he has given us and of the great goodness he has shown to the house of Israel. He has shown this goodness to them in keeping with his compassion and his abundant steadfast love.

public_domain_references.asv: I will make mention of the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah, [and] the praises of Jehovah, according to all that Jehovah hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, [and] the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
public_domain_references.brenton: I remembered the mercy of the Lord, the praises of the Lord in all things wherein he recompenses us. The Lord is a good judge to the house of Israel; he deals with us according to his mercy, and according to the abundance of his righteousness.

pob.text: For he said[a], “Surely they are my people, children who will not deal falsely”; so he became their Savior.

spob.text: For he said, “They truly are my people, children who will not act deceitfully.[a]” So he became their Savior.

public_domain_references.bsb: For He said, “They are surely My people, sons who will not be disloyal.” So He became their Savior.
public_domain_references.web: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.
public_domain_references.asv: For he said, Surely, they are my people, children that will not deal falsely: so he was their Saviour.
public_domain_references.kjv: For he said, Surely they [are] my people, children [that] will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he said, Is it not my people? the children surely will not be rebellious: and he became to them deliverance

pob.text: In all their distress[a], he was distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them; in his love and in his compassion he redeemed them, and he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.

spob.text: Throughout all their distress, he was not distressed.[a] The angel of his presence saved them. Because of his love and compassion, he redeemed them. He lifted them up and carried them throughout the days of long ago.

public_domain_references.kjv: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
public_domain_references.brenton: out of all their affliction: not an ambassador, nor a messenger, but himself saved them, because he loved them and spared them: he himself redeemed them, and took them up, and lifted them up all the days of old.

spob.text: They will go out and look at the dead bodies of the men who rebelled against me. For the worm[a] that feeds on them will not die, and their fire will never be put out. Everyone will find them repulsive.

public_domain_references.bsb: “As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.”
public_domain_references.web: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”
public_domain_references.asv: And they shall go forth, and look upon the dead bodies of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall go forth, and see the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, and their fire shall not be quenched; and they shall be a spectacle to all flesh.
